---
title: "Course readings"
---

Primary research articles paired with each week's material. Each weekly quiz
includes at least one question answerable from that week's paper (abstract
and figures). Access via the DOI links (on campus or through the
[UC Davis library VPN](https://www.library.ucdavis.edu/service/connect-from-off-campus/)).

|---|---|---|
